findings.evidence: Grep of `continuous_mk|isOpen_of_isAdic` in Mathlib's `AdicTopology.lean` finds nothing; the fact is only available inside this proof.
findings.fix: Move it into a named lemma (e.g. `IsAdic.continuous_quotient_mk` under `[DiscreteTopology (R ⧸ I)]`) and use that lemma here.
findings.issue: The `hmk` block proves continuity of `Ideal.Quotient.mk I` (I-adic topology, discrete quotient) inline. This is a reusable standalone fact.

findings.evidence: Mathlib has only the `n = 0` case: `Teichmuller.lean:206 coeff_zero_symm_quotientMulEquiv`.
findings.fix: Factor out `semiconj_symm_quotientMulEquiv_pthRootMonoidHom` and `coeffMonoidHom_symm_quotientMulEquiv` (the general-`n` form of `coeff_zero_symm_quotientMulEquiv`). Then `hg` becomes one line.
findings.issue: The `he`/`hs` block proves the general coordinate formula `coeffMonoidHom R p n ((quotientMulEquiv p I).symm x) = teichmuller₀ p I ((pthRootMonoidHom _ p)^[n] x)` and the semiconjugation by `pthRootMonoidHom` as nested local `have`s. Both are reusable API facts.

findings.evidence: Mathlib already has the simp lemma `coeff_quotientMulEquiv` (`Teichmuller.lean:203`), so the definitional unfolding is unnecessary.
findings.fix: Prove it by `Perfection.ext` plus `simp [coeff_quotientMulEquiv]` (with the `coeff_pthRoot` simp lemma), or keep it as part of the factored semiconj lemma above.
findings.issue: `hfwd` is proved by `rfl`, which unfolds both `quotientMulEquiv` and `pthRootMonoidHom` to their definitions. The comment documents it, but the proof breaks if either definition changes.

summary: The proofs work, but `isHomeomorph_quotientMulEquiv` hides two reusable facts inside a long `have` chain and proves `hfwd` by unfolding `rfl` when Mathlib's simp lemmas would do.
